slim2.scope: Separate complex and real MAC categories, not total FLOPs. FFT proxy adopts shared accounting convention; Python uses direct matrices and keeps literal identity GEMM / unit gain arithmetic. CP-fold addition count is an algebraic mapping count, not measured CPU work. Excludes RMS, nonlinearities, division, memory traffic and control; not an HLS resource/latency prediction.
